Herbed Chicken Thighs

45 min • Serves 4

Grab ingredients

  • 1 1/2 lb bone-in chicken thighs
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • ½ tsp smoked paprika
  • Salt to taste
  • Garlic (minced)

Cook & enjoy

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F and line a tray.
  2. Toss chicken with spices, then stir in 3 cloves garlic before roasting.
